ShortDescription.Value: Cities: Skylines 2 Multiplayer mod, build one shared city with a friend

Publish.LongDescription:
Play Cities: Skylines II together.
CS2 Multiplayer is a client-server multiplayer mod that allows multiple players to build and manage the same city in real time. **Mods currently do not work in Multiplayer!** The mod is currently experimental. Please back up your saves and expect bugs, missing features or crashes while development continues. To host a game, start a multiplayer world, optionally protect it with a password, and share your IP address with your friends or share ur steamcode. If you encounter any issues or have feedback, our Discord server ( https://discord.gg/KFZTW2YSJt ) is the preferred place to get support and report bugs. This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Colossal Order, Paradox Interactive, or Iceflake Studio.
Publish.ChangeLog:
This update focuses on synchronization, chat and general stability.
**Synchronization** - Renamed streets, buildings, districts and other entities now sync. - Normally spawned residential buildings sync, including households, rent and income.
**Fixes** - The same error message could appear twice, even after being closed. - Several chat layout issues and redundant messages. - Multiple unnecessary resync triggers.
**Quality of life** - ESC closes all supported screens, and leaves the chat input. - Steam players get their Steam name as the preset player name. - A mod checker that can be disabled in the mod settings. - New languages: French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese. - Clearer errors and warnings, with references to the help pages. - A new documentation site covering setup, connections and every error the mod can show.
This version cannot connect to 0.1.5 or older; every player needs 0.1.6.
